kernel_contribution.kernel_differs_from_.reason: The implemented matrix-valued covariance combines differentiated compact potentials with signed, antisymmetric rotary cross-covariance and separate support ellipsoids. kernel_contribution.adaptation_motivated.reason: Stream-function and velocity-potential derivatives encode rotational and convergent flow; the rotary term encodes clockwise near-inertial motion. Its longer support is motivated by measured cross-drifter coherence extending to 30 km.

kernel_contribution.domain_warrants_new_.reason: The domain involves coupled vector components, oscillatory cross-covariance, heterogeneous sampling and nonstationary flow regimes. These structures affect both predictive quality and the feasible support pattern, making it more demanding than stationary scalar interpolation on Euclidean coordinates.

insight_contribution.insight_present.reason: The work identifies near-inertial coherence beyond nominal submesoscale support as the dominant residual structure and connects posterior divergence to later drifter clustering. insight_contribution.insight_grounded_in.reason: The principal insights trace to saved rotary spectra, residual correlations, fitted frequencies, variance partitions, derived kinematics and clustering bootstraps.
